function fetchBodyNames(locale?): Promise<SFBodyNames | null>

Defined in: experiments/star-field/star/dossier.ts:146

Fetches the locale's body-name table — data/<locale>/names.json, with the canonical English file as fallback. One ~6 KB document per locale, cached per locale code: the navigator renders localized rows and the router reads/writes translated body segments without pulling all 143 dossier files.

Parameters

locale?

string | null

Active locale code — defaults to the store's current.

Returns

Promise<SFBodyNames | null>

The names table, or null when both fetches fail.
